tagline: The only spec that buffs both Bear and Cat. Pick bear tank for dungeons; run flags and burst as a cat in battlegrounds.
verdict: Feral Combat is a 51-point tree in a game that gives you 51 points, so you can take every single talent. That makes the build question about which role you play, not which talents you skip. Icy Veins calls Feral the only specialization in Forever whose talents buff both tanking and DPS: Ferocity trims Rage and Energy costs in both forms, Predatory Strikes adds Attack Power in Cat, Bear and Dire Bear, and Sharpened Claws, Savage Fury and Predatory Instincts all apply across forms.

For level-60 dungeons and the Dec 9 raids I pick Bear Form tank, not Cat DPS. Blizzard's deep dive gave the bear most of the new toys: Lacerate (a 15-sec stacking bleed at level 42), Primal Bite (a 20-Rage, very-high-threat strike), Thick Hide that turns Defense skill into armor, Natural Reaction for dodge and Rage, Frenzied Regeneration for 100% of max health, a Growl on Warrior-Taunt cooldown, and Berserk. Cat got a buffed Claw, Shred and Rake and little else; Icy Veins notes it plays 'very similar' to Classic, and every list that ranks Feral as DPS puts it in the third band (MMOExp, Overgear, the Blizzard-forum thread). Tanks are the scarcer role.

The risk is real. Icy Veins flags that druid is the one tank with no easy way to strip crits and Crushing Blows, which could hurt in harder content, and nothing above level 30 is playable on the beta yet. The client talent file also lags the dev notes: Blizzard says Shifting Power, Improved Shifting Power and a Shredding Attacks row move are 'new to next week's build', so the Cat side of the tree may change as soon as the next beta patch.
strengths: Talents pay out in both forms: Ferocity, Predatory Strikes, Sharpened Claws and Savage Fury all work in Cat and Bear (Blizzard / Icy Veins).
Among the fastest specs: Feral Swiftness gives +30% Cat Form speed, shapeshifting breaks roots and slows, and Feral Charge has a Cat version on a 30-sec cooldown (Icy Veins / Blizzard).
Bear toolkit is now deep: Lacerate, Primal Bite, Frenzied Regeneration for 100% of max health, Growl on Taunt cooldown, Enrage with 10 starting Rage.
Leader of the Pack gives +3% crit to the party and works in Cat, Bear and Dire Bear Forms; all potions, weapon enchants, Windfury and racials now work while shapeshifted.
weaknesses: Utility is thin: Entangling Roots is the only crowd control and it does little against casters (Icy Veins), and druids cannot snare, silence or interrupt (Blizzard).
Icy Veins flags druid as the only tank with no easy way to remove critical strikes and Crushing Blows, which may bite in raids.
Cat has few new tools beyond a buffed Claw and Shred, and Shifting Power is not in the build we vendored.
Slow early game: Bear Form unlocks at level 10 and Cat Form at 20, and every DPS-spec listing we found puts Feral in the third band.

pvp.title: Cat flag carrier: take the whole Feral tree
pvp.summary: All 51 points in Feral. Run flags in Cat Form with Feral Swiftness, shapeshift out of roots and slows, use Berserk to shrug fear, and switch to Bear Form with Frenzied Regeneration when you are caught.

stats.note: Theory for a flag carrier. Icy Veins ranks Weapon DPS, Hit and Expertise, Critical Strike, Strength, Agility, Stamina for general Feral play; I flip Stamina to the front because a carrier's job is to stay alive. Agility gives crit, dodge and Attack Power in Cat Form. Item stats are hidden until drops.

alliance.why: Quickness adds +2% movement speed and +1% dodge, Shadowmeld now works in form, and Elune's Light is a 10% crit burst on a 3-min cooldown.

horde.why: 5% Health and a War Stomp that stuns up to 5 enemies for 2 sec (usable in form) let a carrier survive a gang; Plainsrunning is bonus speed when you are not being hit.

playstyle: Flag carrier in WSG: stay in Cat Form for Feral Swiftness (+30% speed) and shift out of any root or snare, since shapeshifting breaks them (Icy Veins).
Burst role in AB and Darkspear Islands: Tiger's Fury plus King of the Jungle gives a 60-Energy refill, then Shred or Claw into Rip for a short burst window.
Berserk (3-min cooldown, 15 sec) removes Fear and grants immunity to it, and boosts combo-point generator crit chance by 100% in Cat.
Feral Charge in Cat Form has a 30-sec cooldown and neither interrupts nor immobilizes, so use it as a gap-closer; the Bear version immobilizes and interrupts for 4 sec.
When caught, drop into Bear Form: Thick Hide, Frenzied Regeneration (100% of max health over the duration) and Bash from a shorter cooldown (Brutal Impact) buy time.
AV 40v40: Leader of the Pack gives your group +3% crit; escort the Battle Standard carrier.

pvp.gearNote: Rare PvP gear needs level 55. Priorities: Insignia trinket (R2, Honor only), Faction Cloak (R3: 10 AB Marks + 3,000 Honor), Faction Necklace (R4). Battle Standard (R7, 15% max health aura, 10-min cooldown) is for AV and node pushes. Elite Chest and Helm (R13) and Legs and Shoulders (R12) are the biggest slots, and Elite Boots (R9) matter for a runner; stats are hidden, so slot count rather than a named BiS drives priority. R14 lists a Premier Grand Marshal's Stave (20 AV Marks + 15,000 Honor).

pve.title: Bear tank: Feral minus King of the Jungle, plus Furor
pve.summary: I pick the Bear Form tank over Cat DPS for dungeons and raids. Take the entire Feral tree except King of the Jungle (a Cat-only Tiger's Fury talent) and put those 3 points into Furor for a 60% chance of 10 Rage on shifting into Bear.

stats.note: Projection for a tank. Thick Hide turns Defense skill above 5x level into armor in Bear Form, so Defense is a real stat for druids; Icy Veins' general list is Weapon DPS, Hit and Expertise, Critical Strike, Strength, Agility, Stamina. Weapon DPS carries into Bear Form attacks and sets threat, so it stays high. Item stats are hidden until drops.

alliance.why: Quickness adds +1% dodge and +2% movement speed, and Elune's Light is a 10% crit burst every 3 min for threat and Rage generation.

horde.why: 5% more Health on top of Heart of the Wild's +20% Bear Stamina, and War Stomp stuns up to 5 adds for 2 sec in dungeon pulls.

playstyle: Core bear rotation: Primal Bite on pull for very high threat, Lacerate to build the 5-stack bleed (10% weapon damage per stack), Maul to dump excess Rage, Swipe on three or more targets.
Rage comes from taking damage, Natural Reaction (100% to gain 5 Rage per dodge) and Blood Frenzy (+5 Rage on every crit); Furor adds 10 Rage when you shift into Bear.
Berserk (15 sec, 3-min cooldown) removes Primal Bite's cooldown and makes it strike up to 3 targets; use it on pulls and for fear-casting packs.
Frenzied Regeneration heals 100% of max health over its duration if you have the Rage, and Feral Charge (Bear) interrupts casting for 4 sec.
Growl now shares the Warrior Taunt cooldown and Demoralizing Roar matches Demoralizing Shout at level 60 (Blizzard).
You cannot remove crits or Crushing Blows easily (Icy Veins); stack Defense and Stamina and rely on Thick Hide's armor.

leveling.title: Bear-first leveler ending on the PvE tank build
leveling.summary: Ferocity first for Rage economy, then Savage Fury, Sharpened Claws, Primal Bite and Blood Frenzy through level 30. After that you fill Predatory Strikes, Leader of the Pack, Thick Hide, Heart of the Wild, Natural Reaction, Rend and Tear and Berserk, ending on the PvE allocation with no respec.

stats.note: Icy Veins' Feral order for beta. Weapon DPS sets your form's auto-attack damage and ability damage, so a better weapon is the best upgrade. Hit and Expertise are rare below the late levels.

alliance.why: Quickness gives +2% movement speed and +1% dodge, Shadowmeld works in form, and Elune's Light helps with hard pulls.

horde.why: Plainsrunning builds to +30% run speed and Icy Veins says Tauren 'stands out on lower levels' with extra Health and 1% hit.

playstyle: Before 10 you use Wrath and Moonfire; at level 10 take the Bear Form quest and level mostly as a bear, healing yourself with Mana between pulls (Icy Veins).
Cat Form unlocks via a quest at level 20 and lets you Prowl; use Cat as your travel and sneaking form with Feral Swiftness.
Levels 10-14: Ferocity cuts the cost of Maul, Primal Bite, Swipe, Claw and Rake by up to 5 Rage or Energy.
Brutal Impact (levels 15-16) shortens the Bash cooldown by 30 sec; Feral Charge arrives at 20 as the 11-point talent.
Level 25 gives Primal Bite as soon as the row 4 gate opens; Lacerate is a trainer spell at 42, right as Natural Reaction fills in.
Consumables work in form, so keep Healing and Rage Potions on your bar.
